LanguageData.AMJ_Culture_EntranceAddDesc: Mark a shoe-changing threshold beside a no-shoes area (shared edge). May overlap floors and other zones. Unconnected cells do not trigger changes; no physical footwear item is equipped or removed.
LanguageData.AMJ_Culture_EntranceRemoveDesc: Erase painted shoe-change threshold cells without removing any floor or other zone.
LanguageData.AMJ_Culture_EntranceNotAdjacent: This shoe-change threshold does not share an edge with a no-shoes area. No shoe change will occur.
LanguageData.AMJ_Culture_NoShoesAddDesc: Mark rooms and floors where shoes are removed, such as raised wooden interiors. Paint beside a shoe-change threshold. Other zones and flooring are not affected.
LanguageData.AMJ_Culture_NoShoesRemoveDesc: Clear no-shoes area cells without changing flooring or other zones.
